scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace client && npm run lint --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace client
